sentences.zh: 幽州亂，楊志誠逐李載義，帝不時召宰相問計，僧孺曰：「是不足為朝廷憂。

translations.literal: When Youzhou fell into disorder, Yang Zhicheng drove out Li Zaiyi; the Emperor did not promptly summon the chancellors to ask their plan; Sengru said: "This is not enough to worry the court.
translations.idiomatic: When Youzhou fell into disorder, Yang Zhicheng drove out Li Zaiyi; the Emperor did not promptly summon the chancellors to ask their plan; Sengru said: "This is not enough to worry the court.

sentences.zh: 夫范陽自安、史後，國家無所系休戚，前日劉總挈境歸國，荒財耗力且百萬，終不得范陽尺帛鬥粟入天府，俄復失之。

translations.literal: Since An and Shi, Fanyang has had no tie of shared weal and woe with the state; earlier Liu Zong surrendered his territory to the state, wasting wealth and strength of nearly a million, yet in the end not a foot of cloth or a peck of grain from Fanyang entered the imperial treasury, and soon it was lost again.
translations.idiomatic: Since An and Shi, Fanyang has had no tie of shared weal and woe with the state; earlier Liu Zong surrendered his territory to the state, wasting wealth and strength of nearly a million, yet in the end not a foot of cloth or a peck of grain from Fanyang entered the imperial treasury, and soon it was lost again.

sentences.zh: 今志誠繇向載義也，第付以節使扞奚、契丹，彼且自力，不足以逆順治也。」

translations.literal: Now Zhicheng came from driving out Zaiyi; simply entrust him with the military commission to hold off the Xi and Khitan, and he will exert himself—this is not enough to overturn order whether by compliance or defiance."
translations.idiomatic: Now Zhicheng came from driving out Zaiyi; simply entrust him with the military commission to hold off the Xi and Khitan, and he will exert himself—this is not enough to overturn order whether by compliance or defiance.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「吾初不計此，公言是也。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "I did not calculate this at first; your words are right."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "I did not calculate this at first; your words are right.

sentences.zh: 因遣使慰撫之。

translations.literal: Thereupon he sent envoys to comfort and reassure him.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he sent envoys to comfort and reassure him.

sentences.zh: 進門下侍郎、弘文館大學士。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Institute.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Chancellery and Grand Academician of the Hongwen Institute.

sentences.zh: 是時，吐蕃請和，約弛兵，而大酋悉怛謀舉維州入之劍南，於是李德裕上言：「韋皋經略西山，至死恨不能致，今以生羌二千人燒十三橋，搗虜之虛，可以得志。」

translations.literal: At the time Tibet requested peace and agreed to relax troops, but the great chieftain Sidu Mou led Weizhou to surrender to Jiannan; thereupon Li Deyu submitted: "Wei Gao administered the western mountains and to his death regretted he could not take it; now with two thousand living Qiang he can burn the thirteen bridges and strike at the enemy's emptiness—success can be achieved.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Tibet requested peace and agreed to relax troops, but the great chieftain Sidu Mou led Weizhou to surrender to Jiannan; thereupon Li Deyu submitted: "Wei Gao administered the western mountains and to his death regretted he could not take it; now with two thousand living Qiang he can burn the thirteen bridges and strike at the enemy's emptiness—success can be achieved.

sentences.zh: 帝使君臣大議，請如德裕策。

translations.literal: The Emperor had ministers debate at length and requested to follow Deyu's plan.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had ministers debate at length and requested to follow Deyu's plan.

sentences.zh: 僧孺持不可，曰：「吐蕃綿地萬里，失一維州，無害其強。

translations.literal: Sengru held it impossible, saying: "Tibet's territory extends ten thousand li; losing one Weizhou does not harm its strength.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru held it impossible, saying: "Tibet's territory extends ten thousand li; losing one Weizhou does not harm its strength.

sentences.zh: 今脩好使者尚未至，遽反其言。

translations.literal: The envoys seeking good relations have not yet arrived, yet we abruptly go back on our word.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys seeking good relations have not yet arrived, yet we abruptly go back on our word.

sentences.zh: 且中國禦戎，守信為上，應敵次之。

translations.literal: Moreover, in defending against barbarians China values keeping faith above all and responding to the enemy second.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in defending against barbarians China values keeping faith above all and responding to the enemy second.

sentences.zh: 彼來責曰：'何故失信？

translations.literal: If they come to charge us, saying: 'Why break faith?
translations.idiomatic: If they come to charge us, saying: 'Why break faith?

sentences.zh: '贊普牧馬蔚茹川，若東襲隴阪，以騎綴回中，不三日抵咸陽橋，則京師戒嚴，雖得百維州何益！」

translations.literal: The prince regent pastures horses at Weiruchuan; if he strikes east at Longban with cavalry trailing to Huizhong, in less than three days he reaches Xianyang Bridge, then the capital is put on alert—what good would a hundred Weizhous do!"
translations.idiomatic: The prince regent pastures horses at Weiruchuan; if he strikes east at Longban with cavalry trailing to Huizhong, in less than three days he reaches Xianyang Bridge, then the capital is put on alert—what good would a hundred Weizhous do!

sentences.zh: 帝然之，遂詔返降者。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved and thereupon ordered the surrenderers returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved and thereupon ordered the surrenderers returned.

sentences.zh: 時皆謂僧孺挾素怨，橫議沮解之，帝亦以為不直。

translations.literal: At the time all said Sengru harbored an old grudge and arbitrarily debated to obstruct and dissolve the plan; the Emperor also considered it unjust.
translations.idiomatic: At the time all said Sengru harbored an old grudge and arbitrarily debated to obstruct and dissolve the plan; the Emperor also considered it unjust.

sentences.zh: 會中人王守澄引纖人竊議朝政，它日延英召見宰相曰：「公等有意于太平乎？

translations.literal: When the eunuch Wang Shoucheng introduced petty men who secretly discussed court affairs, on another day at Yanying he summoned the chancellors and said: "Do you gentlemen wish for great peace?
translations.idiomatic: When the eunuch Wang Shoucheng introduced petty men who secretly discussed court affairs, on another day at Yanying he summoned the chancellors and said: "Do you gentlemen wish for great peace?

sentences.zh: 何道以致之？」

translations.literal: By what Way can it be attained?"
translations.idiomatic: By what Way can it be attained?

sentences.zh: 僧孺曰：「臣待罪宰相，不能康濟，然太平亦無象。

translations.literal: Sengru said: "Your subject holds a chancellor's post yet cannot bring prosperity; yet great peace likewise has no fixed sign.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru said: "Your subject holds a chancellor's post yet cannot bring prosperity; yet great peace likewise has no fixed sign.

sentences.zh: 今四夷不內擾，百姓安生業，私室無強家，上不壅蔽，下不怨讟，雖未及至盛，亦足為治矣。

translations.literal: Now the four barbarians do not disturb within, the common people secure their livelihoods, no powerful house in private quarters, the ruler is not blocked above and none complain below—though not yet reaching the utmost flourishing, it is enough for governance.
translations.idiomatic: Now the four barbarians do not disturb within, the common people secure their livelihoods, no powerful house in private quarters, the ruler is not blocked above and none complain below—though not yet reaching the utmost flourishing, it is enough for governance.

sentences.zh: 而更求太平，非臣所及。」

translations.literal: To seek great peace beyond this is not within your subject's reach."
translations.idiomatic: To seek great peace beyond this is not within your subject's reach.

sentences.zh: 退謂它宰相曰：「上責成如是，吾可久處此耶？」

translations.literal: Retiring he said to the other chancellors: "The ruler demands achievement like this—can I long remain in this post?"
translations.idiomatic: Retiring he said to the other chancellors: "The ruler demands achievement like this—can I long remain in this post?

sentences.zh: 固請罷，乃檢校尚書左僕射平章事，為淮南節度副大使。

translations.literal: He firmly requested dismissal and was made Honorary Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Director of the Chancellery, serving as deputy military governor of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: He firmly requested dismissal and was made Honorary Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Director of the Chancellery, serving as deputy military governor of Huainan.

sentences.zh: 天子既急於治，故李訓等投隙得售其妄，幾至亡國。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven, eager for good governance, therefore Li Xun and others found an opening to sell their delusions and nearly brought the state to ruin.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven, eager for good governance, therefore Li Xun and others found an opening to sell their delusions and nearly brought the state to ruin.

sentences.zh: 開成初，表解劇鎮，以檢校司空為東都留守。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaicheng he memorialized to be relieved of the arduous command and was made Honorary Grand Guardian as Eastern Capital Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaicheng he memorialized to be relieved of the arduous command and was made Honorary Grand Guardian as Eastern Capital Intendant.

sentences.zh: 僧孺治第洛之歸仁裏，多致嘉石美木，與賓客相娛樂。

translations.literal: Sengru built a residence in Guiren Lane in Luoyang, gathering many fine stones and beautiful trees to enjoy himself with guests.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru built a residence in Guiren Lane in Luoyang, gathering many fine stones and beautiful trees to enjoy himself with guests.

sentences.zh: 三年，召為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In the third year he was summoned as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was summoned as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 僧孺入朝，會莊恪太子薨，既見，陳父子君臣人倫大經，以悟帝意，帝泫然流涕。

translations.literal: When Sengru entered court, Prince Zhuangke had just died; upon audience he set forth the great norms of the relations between father and son and ruler and minister to awaken the Emperor's mind, and the Emperor wept.
translations.idiomatic: When Sengru entered court, Prince Zhuangke had just died; upon audience he set forth the great norms of the relations between father and son and ruler and minister to awaken the Emperor's mind, and the Emperor wept.

sentences.zh: 以足疾不任謁，檢校司空、平章事，為山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: Afflicted with foot ailment he could not perform audience and was made Honorary Grand Guardian and Director of the Chancellery, serving as military governor of Shannan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Afflicted with foot ailment he could not perform audience and was made Honorary Grand Guardian and Director of the Chancellery, serving as military governor of Shannan East Circuit.

sentences.zh: 賜彝樽、龍勺，詔曰；

translations.literal: He was granted ritual vessels and a dragon ladle; an edict said;
translations.idiomatic: He was granted ritual vessels and a dragon ladle; an edict said;

sentences.zh: 「精金古器以比況君子，卿宜少留。」

translations.literal: "Refined metal and ancient vessels are used to compare with gentlemen—you should stay a while longer."
translations.idiomatic: "Refined metal and ancient vessels are used to compare with gentlemen—you should stay a while longer.

sentences.zh: 僧孺固請，乃行。

translations.literal: Sengru firmly requested and then departed.
translations.idiomatic: Sengru firmly requested and then departed.

sentences.zh: 會昌元年，漢水溢，壞城郭，坐不謹防，下遷太子少保。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huichang the Han River overflowed and destroyed walls and towns; for failure to guard carefully he was demoted to Junior Guardian to the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Huichang the Han River overflowed and destroyed walls and towns; for failure to guard carefully he was demoted to Junior Guardian to the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 進少師。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 明年，以太子太傅留守東都。

translations.literal: The next year he was made Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince and Eastern Capital Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was made Grand Preceptor to the Crown Prince and Eastern Capital Intendant.

sentences.zh: 劉稹誅，而石雄軍吏得從諫與僧孺、李宗閔交結狀。

translations.literal: When Liu Zhen was executed, Shi Xiong's army officers obtained evidence of correspondence between Congjian and Sengru and Li Zongmin.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Zhen was executed, Shi Xiong's army officers obtained evidence of correspondence between Congjian and Sengru and Li Zongmin.

sentences.zh: 又河南少尹呂述言：「僧孺聞稹誅，恨歎之。」

translations.literal: Also Henan Assistant Intendant Lu Shu said: "When Sengru heard of Zhen's execution he sighed in regret."
translations.idiomatic: Also Henan Assistant Intendant Lu Shu said: "When Sengru heard of Zhen's execution he sighed in regret.

sentences.zh: 武宗怒，黜為太子少保，分司東都，累貶循州長史。

translations.literal: Wuzong grew angry and demoted him to Junior Guardian to the Crown Prince, branch office of the Eastern Capital, and repeatedly demoted him to Senior Administrator of Xunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzong grew angry and demoted him to Junior Guardian to the Crown Prince, branch office of the Eastern Capital, and repeatedly demoted him to Senior Administrator of Xunzhou.

sentences.zh: 宣宗立，徙衡、汝二州，還為太子少師。

translations.literal: When Xuanzong took the throne he was transferred to Heng and Ru prefectures and returned as Junior Preceptor to the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuanzong took the throne he was transferred to Heng and Ru prefectures and returned as Junior Preceptor to the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈太尉，年六十九。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Marshal at age sixty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Marshal at the age of sixty-nine.

sentences.zh: 諡曰文簡。

translations.literal: He was given the posthumous name Wenjian.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous name Wenjian.

sentences.zh: 諸子蔚、叢最顯。

translations.literal: Among his sons Wei and Cong were most prominent.
translations.idiomatic: Among his sons Wei and Cong were most prominent.

sentences.zh: 子 蔚蔚，字大章，少擢兩經，又第進士，繇監察御史為右補闕。

translations.literal: His son Wei, styled Dazhang, passed both Classics examinations while young, also passed the jinshi, and from Investigating Censor became Right Remonstrance Officer.
translations.idiomatic: His son Wei, styled Dazhang, passed both Classics examinations while young, also passed the jinshi, and from Investigating Censor became Right Remonstrance Officer.

sentences.zh: 大中初，屢條切政，宣宗喜曰：「牛氏果有子，差尉人意。」

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong he repeatedly set forth cutting policies; Xuanzong was pleased and said: "The Niu family indeed has a son—this somewhat eases one's mind."
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Dazhong he repeatedly set forth cutting policies; Xuanzong was pleased and said: "The Niu family indeed has a son—this somewhat eases one's mind.

sentences.zh: 出金州刺史，遷累吏部郎中。

translations.literal: He was sent out as Prefect of Jinzhou and promoted through accumulated appointments to Director of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as Prefect of Jinzhou and promoted through accumulated appointments to Director of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 失權幸意，貶國子博士，分司東都。

translations.literal: He lost the favor of the powerful and was demoted to Erudite of the Directorate of Education, branch office of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: He lost the favor of the powerful and was demoted to Erudite of the Directorate of Education, branch office of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 復以吏部召，兼史館修撰。

translations.literal: He was again summoned to the Board of Personnel and concurrently made Compiler of the Historiography Institute.
translations.idiomatic: He was again summoned to the Board of Personnel and concurrently made Compiler of the Historiography Institute.

sentences.zh: 咸通中，進至戶部侍郎，襲奇章侯。

translations.literal: In the Xiantong era he advanced to Vice Minister of Revenue and inherited the Marquisate of Qizhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xiantong era he advanced to Vice Minister of Revenue and inherited the Marquisate of Qizhang.

sentences.zh: 坐累免，未一歲，復官。

translations.literal: Implicated and dismissed, within a year he was restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: Implicated and dismissed, within a year he was restored to office.

sentences.zh: 久之，檢校兵部尚書、山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: After a long time he was made Honorary Minister of War and military governor of Shannan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was made Honorary Minister of War and military governor of Shannan West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 治梁三年，徐州盜起，神策兩中尉諷諸籓悉財助軍，蔚索府帛三萬以獻，中人嫌其吝，用吳行魯代之。

translations.literal: Governing Liang for three years, when bandits rose at Xuzhou the two Army Supervising Eunuchs of the Shence Armies hinted that all military governors should contribute wealth to aid the army; Wei demanded thirty thousand bolts of cloth from the prefecture to present, and the eunuchs resented his stinginess and had Wu Xinglu replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Governing Liang for three years, when bandits rose at Xuzhou the two Army Supervising Eunuchs of the Shence Armies hinted that all military governors should contribute wealth to aid the army; Wei demanded thirty thousand bolts of cloth from the prefecture to present, and the eunuchs resented his stinginess and had Wu Xinglu replace him.

sentences.zh: 黃巢入京師，遁山南，故吏民喜蔚至，爭迎候。

translations.literal: When Huang Chao entered the capital Wei fled to Shannan; former officials and people were glad he had come and vied to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: When Huang Chao entered the capital Wei fled to Shannan; former officials and people were glad he had come and vied to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 因請老，以尚書右僕射致仕，卒。

translations.literal: He then requested retirement, retired with the title Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He then requested retirement, retired with the title Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and died.

sentences.zh: 子徽。

translations.literal: His son was Hui.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Hui.

sentences.zh: 蔚子 微徽舉進士，累擢吏部員外郎。

translations.literal: Wei's son Hui passed the jinshi and was promoted through accumulated appointments to Vice Director of the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's son Hui passed the jinshi and was promoted through accumulated appointments to Vice Director of the Board of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 乾符中選濫，吏多奸，歲調四千員，徽治以剛明，柅杜幹請，法度復振。

translations.literal: In the Qianfu era selection was excessive and officials were mostly corrupt; forty thousand posts were adjusted annually; Hui governed with stern clarity, checked improper requests, and regulations were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the Qianfu era selection was excessive and officials were mostly corrupt; forty thousand posts were adjusted annually; Hui governed with stern clarity, checked improper requests, and regulations were restored.

sentences.zh: 蔚避地于梁，道病，徽與子扶籃輿，曆閣路，盜擊其首，血流面，持輿不息。

translations.literal: When Wei fled to Liang he fell ill on the road; Hui and his son carried the litter along mountain paths; bandits struck his head and blood flowed over his face, yet he did not stop carrying the litter.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei fled to Liang he fell ill on the road; Hui and his son carried the litter along mountain paths; bandits struck his head and blood flowed over his face, yet he did not stop carrying the litter.

sentences.zh: 盜迫之，徽拜曰：「人皆有父，今親老而疾，幸無駭驚。」

translations.literal: The bandits pressed him; Hui bowed and said: "All men have fathers; now my parent is old and ill—please do not frighten him."
translations.idiomatic: The bandits pressed him; Hui bowed and said: "All men have fathers; now my parent is old and ill—please do not frighten him.

sentences.zh: 盜感之，乃止。

translations.literal: The bandits were moved and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits were moved and stopped.

sentences.zh: 及前穀，又逢盜，輒相語曰：「此孝子也！」

translations.literal: When they reached the previous valley they again met bandits, who said to one another: "This is a filial son!"
translations.idiomatic: When they reached the previous valley they again met bandits, who said to one another: "This is a filial son!

sentences.zh: 共舉輿舍之家，進帛裹創，以饘飲奉蔚，留信宿去。

translations.literal: Together they lifted the litter and lodged them in a house, presented cloth to wrap the wound, and with gruel and drink served Wei, staying two nights before leaving.
translations.idiomatic: Together they lifted the litter and lodged them in a house, presented cloth to wrap the wound, and with gruel and drink served Wei, staying two nights before leaving.

sentences.zh: 抵梁，徽趨蜀謁行在，丐歸侍親疾。

translations.literal: Reaching Liang, Hui hurried to Shu to attend the mobile court and begged to return to tend his parent's illness.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Liang, Hui hurried to Shu to attend the mobile court and begged to return to tend his parent's illness.

sentences.zh: 會拜諫議大夫，固辭，見宰相杜讓能曰：「上遷幸當從，親有疾當侍，而徽兄在朝廷，身乞還營醫藥。」

translations.literal: When appointed Remonstrance Officer he firmly declined and said to Chancellor Du Rangneng: "When the ruler moves in flight one should follow; when a parent is ill one should attend—yet my elder brother is at court and I beg to return to prepare medicines."
translations.idiomatic: When appointed Remonstrance Officer he firmly declined and said to Chancellor Du Rangneng: "When the ruler moves in flight one should follow; when a parent is ill one should attend—yet my elder brother is at court and I beg to return to prepare medicines.

sentences.zh: 時兄循已位給事中，許之。

translations.literal: At the time his elder brother Xun already held the post of Supervising Censor and permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: At the time his elder brother Xun already held the post of Supervising Censor and permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 父喪，客梁、漢。

translations.literal: When his father died he stayed as a guest in Liang and Han.
translations.idiomatic: When his father died he stayed as a guest in Liang and Han.

sentences.zh: 終喪，以中書舍人召，辭疾，改給事中，留陳倉。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was summoned as Drafting Secretary but declined on account of illness, changed to Supervising Censor, and remained at Chencang.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was summoned as Drafting Secretary but declined on account of illness, changed to Supervising Censor, and remained at Chencang.

sentences.zh: 張濬伐太原，引為判官，敕在所敦遣。

translations.literal: When Zhang Jun campaigned against Taiyuan he was recruited as staff judge; an edict ordered the locality to escort him.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Jun campaigned against Taiyuan he was recruited as staff judge; an edict ordered the locality to escort him.

sentences.zh: 徽太息曰：「王室方復，廥藏殫耗，當協和諸侯以為籓屏，而又濟以兵，諸侯離心，必有後憂。」

translations.literal: Hui sighed deeply and said: "The royal house is just recovering and the treasury is exhausted; one should harmonize the feudal lords to serve as a screen, yet to aid this with troops will make the feudal lords turn away in heart—there will surely be trouble afterward."
translations.idiomatic: Hui sighed deeply and said: "The royal house is just recovering and the treasury is exhausted; one should harmonize the feudal lords to serve as a screen, yet to aid this with troops will make the feudal lords turn away in heart—there will surely be trouble afterward.

sentences.zh: 不肯起。

translations.literal: He refused to rise.
translations.idiomatic: He refused to rise.

sentences.zh: 濬果敗。

translations.literal: Jun indeed failed.
translations.idiomatic: Jun indeed failed.

sentences.zh: 復召為給事中。

translations.literal: He was again summoned as Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was again summoned as Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 楊復恭叛山南，李茂貞請假招討節伐之，未報，而與王行瑜輒出兵。

translations.literal: When Yang Fugong rebelled in Shannan, Li Maozhen requested a commission as Pacification Commissioner to campaign against him; before a reply came he and Wang Xingyu rashly sent out troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Fugong rebelled in Shannan, Li Maozhen requested a commission as Pacification Commissioner to campaign against him; before a reply came he and Wang Xingyu rashly sent out troops.

sentences.zh: 昭宗怒，持奏不下。

translations.literal: Zhaozong grew angry and withheld the memorial without acting.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaozong grew angry and withheld the memorial without acting.

sentences.zh: 茂貞亟請，帝召群臣議，無敢言。

translations.literal: Maozhen urgently requested; the Emperor summoned ministers to debate and none dared speak."
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen urgently requested; the Emperor summoned ministers to debate and none dared speak.

sentences.zh: 徽曰：「王室多難，茂貞誠有功。

translations.literal: Hui said: "The royal house has many troubles; Maozhen truly has merit.
translations.idiomatic: Hui said: "The royal house has many troubles; Maozhen truly has merit.

sentences.zh: 今復恭阻兵而討之，罪在不俟命爾。

translations.literal: Now Fugong blocks the army while we campaign against him—the crime lies in not awaiting orders.
translations.idiomatic: Now Fugong blocks the army while we campaign against him—the crime lies in not awaiting orders.

sentences.zh: 臣聞兩鎮兵多殺傷，不早有所制，則梁、漢之人盡矣。

translations.literal: Your subject hears that the two circuits' soldiers have killed and wounded many; if control is not exerted early, the people of Liang and Han will be wiped out.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject hears that the two circuits' soldiers have killed and wounded many; if control is not exerted early, the people of Liang and Han will be wiped out.

sentences.zh: 請假以節，明約束，則軍有所畏。」

translations.literal: I request that a commission be granted with clear constraints, so the army will have something to fear."
translations.idiomatic: I request that a commission be granted with clear constraints, so the army will have something to fear.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「然。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "So it shall be."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "So it shall be.

sentences.zh: 乃以招討使授茂貞，果有功，然益偃蹇，帝使宰相杜讓能將兵誅討，徽諫曰：「岐，國西門。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Pacification Commissioner was granted to Maozhen, who indeed had merit, yet grew ever more arrogant; the Emperor had Chancellor Du Rangneng lead troops to suppress him; Hui remonstrated: "Qi is the western gate of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Pacification Commissioner was granted to Maozhen, who indeed had merit, yet grew ever more arrogant; the Emperor had Chancellor Du Rangneng lead troops to suppress him; Hui remonstrated: "Qi is the western gate of the state.

sentences.zh: 茂貞憑其眾而暴，若令萬分一不利，屈威重奈何？

translations.literal: Maozhen relies on his multitude and is violent; if even one part in ten thousand goes badly, how can prestige and weight be bent?
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen relies on his multitude and is violent; if even one part in ten thousand goes badly, how can prestige and weight be bent?

sentences.zh: 願徐制之。」

translations.literal: I wish he be controlled gradually."
translations.idiomatic: I wish he be controlled gradually.

sentences.zh: 不聽。

translations.literal: This was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: This was not heeded.

sentences.zh: 師出，帝復召徽曰：「今伐茂貞，彼眾烏合，取必萬全，卿計何日有捷？」

translations.literal: When the army set out, the Emperor again summoned Hui and said: "Now in campaigning against Maozhen, his multitude is a mob gathered together—victory is sure to be complete; on what day do you calculate success?"
translations.idiomatic: When the army set out, the Emperor again summoned Hui and said: "Now in campaigning against Maozhen, his multitude is a mob gathered together—victory is sure to be complete; on what day do you calculate success?

sentences.zh: 對曰：「臣職諫爭，所言者軍國大體，如索賊平之期，願陛下考蓍龜，責將帥，非臣職也。」

translations.literal: He replied: "Your subject's office is remonstrance; what I speak of is the great body of military and state affairs; as for fixing the date when bandits are pacified, I wish Your Majesty consult divination and hold generals accountable—that is not my office."
translations.idiomatic: He replied: "Your subject's office is remonstrance; what I speak of is the great body of military and state affairs; as for fixing the date when bandits are pacified, I wish Your Majesty consult divination and hold generals accountable—that is not my office.

sentences.zh: 既而師果敗，遂殺大臣，王室益弱。

translations.literal: Before long the army indeed failed, and great ministers were killed; the royal house grew weaker still.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the army indeed failed, and great ministers were killed; the royal house grew weaker still.

sentences.zh: 俄由中書舍人為刑部侍郎，襲奇章男。

translations.literal: Before long he was made Vice Minister of Punishments from Drafting Secretary and inherited the title Lord Qizhang.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was made Vice Minister of Punishments from Drafting Secretary and inherited the title Lord Qizhang.

sentences.zh: 崔胤忌徽之正，換左散常侍，徙太子賓客，以刑部尚書致仕，歸樊川。

translations.literal: Cui Yin resented Hui's uprightness, exchanged him for Left Regular Attendant, transferred him to Mentor to the Crown Prince, and he retired with the title Minister of Punishments and returned to Fanchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yin resented Hui's uprightness, exchanged him for Left Regular Attendant, transferred him to Mentor to the Crown Prince, and he retired with the title Minister of Punishments and returned to Fanchuan.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈吏部尚書。

translations.literal: He died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 子 叢叢，字表齡，第進士，由籓帥幕府任補闕，數言事。

translations.literal: His son Cong, styled Biaoling, passed the jinshi, served in a military governor's staff as Remonstrance Officer, and repeatedly spoke on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His son Cong, styled Biaoling, passed the jinshi, served in a military governor's staff as Remonstrance Officer, and repeatedly spoke on affairs.

sentences.zh: 會宰相請廣諫員，宣宗曰：「諫臣惟能舉職為可，奚用眾耶？

translations.literal: When the chancellor requested expanding remonstrance posts, Xuanzong said: "Remonstrance officials need only perform their duties—that is enough; why need many?
translations.idiomatic: When the chancellor requested expanding remonstrance posts, Xuanzong said: "Remonstrance officials need only perform their duties—that is enough; why need many?

sentences.zh: 今張符、趙璘、牛叢使朕聞所未聞，三人足矣。」

translations.literal: Now Zhang Fu, Zhao Lin, and Niu Cong have let me hear what I had not heard—three men are enough."
translations.idiomatic: Now Zhang Fu, Zhao Lin, and Niu Cong have let me hear what I had not heard—three men are enough.

sentences.zh: 以司勳員外郎為睦州刺史，帝勞曰：「卿非得怨宰相乎？」

translations.literal: He was made Vice Director of the Board of Merit and Prefect of Muzhou; the Emperor comforted him: "Were you not nursing a grudge against the chancellor?"
translations.idiomatic: He was made Vice Director of the Board of Merit and Prefect of Muzhou; the Emperor comforted him: "Were you not nursing a grudge against the chancellor?

sentences.zh: 對曰：「陛下比詔，不由刺史縣令，不任近臣，宰相以是擢臣，非嫌也。」

translations.literal: He replied: "Your Majesty's recent edict was that without prefects and magistrates and close ministers, the chancellor therefore promoted your subject—it was not out of resentment.
translations.idiomatic: He replied: "Your Majesty's recent edict was that without prefects and magistrates and close ministers, the chancellor therefore promoted your subject—it was not out of resentment.

sentences.zh: 即賜金紫，謝曰：「臣今衣刺史所假緋，即賜紫，為越等。」

translations.literal: He was immediately granted gold and purple; he thanked the Emperor: "Your subject now wears the scarlet lent by the prefect yet is granted purple—this exceeds proper rank."
translations.idiomatic: He was immediately granted gold and purple; he thanked the Emperor: "Your subject now wears the scarlet lent by the prefect yet is granted purple—this exceeds proper rank.

sentences.zh: 乃賜銀緋。

translations.literal: He was therefore granted silver scarlet.
translations.idiomatic: He was therefore granted silver scarlet.

sentences.zh: 咸通末，拜劍南西川節度使。

translations.literal: At the end of Xiantong he was appointed military governor of Jiannan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Xiantong he was appointed military governor of Jiannan West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 時蠻犯邊，抵大渡，進略黎、雅、叩邛崍關，謾書求入朝，且曰假道。

translations.literal: At the time the barbarians invaded the border, reaching the Great Crossing, advancing to plunder Li and Ya and knocking at Qionglai Pass; they sent a deceitful letter requesting entry to court and also asked for passage.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the barbarians invaded the border, reaching the Great Crossing, advancing to plunder Li and Ya and knocking at Qionglai Pass; they sent a deceitful letter requesting entry to court and also asked for passage.

sentences.zh: 叢囚其使四十人，釋二人還之，蠻懼，即引去。

translations.literal: Cong imprisoned forty of their envoys and released two to return; the barbarians feared this and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Cong imprisoned forty of their envoys and released two to return; the barbarians feared this and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 僖宗幸蜀，授太常卿。

translations.literal: When Xizong fled to Shu he was appointed Minister of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: When Xizong fled to Shu he was appointed Minister of Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 以病求為巴州刺史，不許。

translations.literal: He requested on account of illness to be Prefect of Bazhou but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He requested on account of illness to be Prefect of Bazhou but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 還京，為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital he was made Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the capital he was made Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 嗣襄王亂，叢客死太原。

translations.literal: In the disorder of the usurping Prince of Xiang he died as a guest at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the disorder of the usurping Prince of Xiang he died as a guest at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 李宗閔李宗閔，字損之，鄭王元懿四世孫。

translations.literal: Li Zongmin Li Zongmin, styled Sunzhi, was a fourth-generation descendant of Prince Yuanyi of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zongmin, styled Sunzhi, was a fourth-generation descendant of Prince Yuanyi of Zheng.

sentences.zh: 擢進士，調華州參軍事。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi and was appointed staff officer of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi and was appointed staff officer of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 舉賢良方正，與牛僧孺詆切時政，觸宰相，李吉甫惡之，補洛陽尉。

translations.literal: He entered the Exemplary and Upright examination and, together with Niu Sengru, criticized current policy, offending the chancellor; Li Jifu hated them and they were appointed Luoyang Assistant Magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the Exemplary and Upright examination and, together with Niu Sengru, criticized current policy, offending the chancellor; Li Jifu hated them and they were appointed Luoyang Assistant Magistrate.

sentences.zh: 久流落不偶，去從籓府辟署。

translations.literal: Long adrift without success, he left to follow a military governor's recruitment.
translations.idiomatic: Long adrift without success, he left to follow a military governor's recruitment.

sentences.zh: 入授監察御史、禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: Entering service he was appointed Investigating Censor and Vice Director of the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Entering service he was appointed Investigating Censor and Vice Director of the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 裴度伐蔡，引為彰義觀察判官。

translations.literal: When Pei Du campaigned against Cai he was recruited as staff judge of the Zhangyi Observation Mission.
translations.idiomatic: When Pei Du campaigned against Cai he was recruited as staff judge of the Zhangyi Observation Mission.

sentences.zh: 蔡平，遷駕部郎中，知制誥。

translations.literal: When Cai was pacified he was transferred to Director of the Board of Transport and put in charge of drafting edicts.
translations.idiomatic: When Cai was pacified he was transferred to Director of the Board of Transport and put in charge of drafting edicts.

sentences.zh: 穆宗即位，進中書舍人。

translations.literal: When Muzong took the throne he was promoted to Drafting Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: When Muzong took the throne he was promoted to Drafting Secretary.

sentences.zh: 時䎖為華州刺史，父子同拜，世以為寵。

translations.literal: At the time Tiao was Prefect of Huazhou; father and son were invested on the same day—the age considered it favor.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Tiao was Prefect of Huazhou; father and son were invested on the same day—the age considered it favor.

sentences.zh: 長慶初，錢徽典貢舉，宗閔托所親於徽，而李德裕、李紳、元稹在翰林，有寵於帝，共白徽納幹丐，取士不以實，宗閔坐貶劍州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Changqing, Qian Hui ran the examination; Zongmin entrusted a close associate to Hui, while Li Deyu, Li Shen, and Yuan Zhen were in the Hanlin and favored by the Emperor; together they reported that Hui accepted bribes and took candidates not on merit; Zongmin was demoted to Prefect of Jianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Changqing, Qian Hui ran the examination; Zongmin entrusted a close associate to Hui, while Li Deyu, Li Shen, and Yuan Zhen were in the Hanlin and favored by the Emperor; together they reported that Hui accepted bribes and took candidates not on merit; Zongmin was demoted to Prefect of Jianzhou.

sentences.zh: 由是嫌忌顯結，樹黨相磨軋，凡四十年，搢紳之禍不能解。

translations.literal: Thereupon mutual suspicion and resentment became openly knotted; factions were formed and ground one another down—for forty years the calamity of gentry officials could not be resolved.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon mutual suspicion and resentment became openly knotted; factions were formed and ground one another down—for forty years the calamity of gentry officials could not be resolved.

sentences.zh: 俄復為中書舍人，典貢舉，所取多知名士，若唐沖、薛庠、袁都等，世謂之「玉筍」。

translations.literal: Before long he again became Drafting Secretary and ran the examination; those he selected were mostly famous scholars such as Tang Chong, Xue Xiang, and Yuan Du; the age called them the "Jade Shoots."
translations.idiomatic: Before long he again became Drafting Secretary and ran the examination; those he selected were mostly famous scholars such as Tang Chong, Xue Xiang, and Yuan Du; the age called them the "Jade Shoots."

sentences.zh: 寶曆初，累進兵部侍郎，父喪解。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Baoli he was promoted through accumulated appointments to Vice Minister of War and resigned on his father's death.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Baoli he was promoted through accumulated appointments to Vice Minister of War and resigned on his father's death.

sentences.zh: 太和中，以吏部侍郎同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era he was made Vice Minister of Personnel and Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era he was made Vice Minister of Personnel and Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 時德裕自浙西召，欲以相，而宗閔中助多，先得進，即引僧孺同秉政，相唱和，去異己者，德裕所善皆逐之。

translations.literal: At the time Deyu was recalled from Zhexi and wished to become chancellor, but Zongmin had many supporters within and advanced first; he then brought in Sengru to share power, singing in accord and removing those unlike themselves; those Deyu favored were all driven away.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Deyu was recalled from Zhexi and wished to become chancellor, but Zongmin had many supporters within and advanced first; he then brought in Sengru to share power, singing in accord and removing those unlike themselves; those Deyu favored were all driven away.

sentences.zh: 遷中書侍郎。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 久之，德裕為相，與宗閔共當國。

translations.literal: After a long time Deyu became chancellor and shared power with Zongmin.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time Deyu became chancellor and shared power with Zongmin.

sentences.zh: 德裕入謝，文宗曰：「而知朝廷有朋黨乎？」

translations.literal: When Deyu entered to give thanks, Wenzong said: "Do you know that the court has factions?"
translations.idiomatic: When Deyu entered to give thanks, Wenzong said: "Do you know that the court has factions?

sentences.zh: 德裕曰：「今中朝半為黨人，雖後來者，趨利而靡，往往陷之。

translations.literal: Deyu said: "Now half of the central court are faction members; even those who come later, chasing profit and bending, often fall into them.
translations.idiomatic: Deyu said: "Now half of the central court are faction members; even those who come later, chasing profit and bending, often fall into them.

sentences.zh: 陛下能用中立無私者，黨與破矣。」

translations.literal: If Your Majesty can employ the impartial and selfless, factions will be broken."
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty can employ the impartial and selfless, factions will be broken.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「眾以楊虞卿、張元夫、蕭澣為黨魁。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "The masses take Yang Yuqing, Zhang Yuanfu, and Xiao Han as faction chiefs."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "The masses take Yang Yuqing, Zhang Yuanfu, and Xiao Han as faction chiefs.

sentences.zh: 德裕因請皆出為刺史，帝然之。

translations.literal: Deyu thereupon requested that all be sent out as prefects; the Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: Deyu thereupon requested that all be sent out as prefects; the Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 即以虞卿為常州，元夫為汝州，蕭澣為鄭州。

translations.literal: Yuqing was immediately made Prefect of Changzhou, Yuanfu of Ruzhou, and Xiao Han of Zhengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yuqing was immediately made Prefect of Changzhou, Yuanfu of Ruzhou, and Xiao Han of Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 宗閔曰：「虞卿位給事中，州不容在元夫下。

translations.literal: Zongmin said: "Yuqing holds the post of Supervising Censor—a prefecture cannot rank below Yuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: Zongmin said: "Yuqing holds the post of Supervising Censor—a prefecture cannot rank below Yuanfu.

sentences.zh: 德裕居外久，其知黨人不如臣之詳。

translations.literal: Deyu has long been outside and knows faction members less well than your subject.
translations.idiomatic: Deyu has long been outside and knows faction members less well than your subject.

sentences.zh: 虞卿日見賓客於第，世號行中書，故臣未嘗與美官。」

translations.literal: Yuqing daily receives guests at his residence—the age calls it the traveling Secretariat; therefore your subject has never given him a fine post."
translations.idiomatic: Yuqing daily receives guests at his residence—the age calls it the traveling Secretariat; therefore your subject has never given him a fine post.

sentences.zh: 德裕質之曰：「給事中非美官雲何？」

translations.literal: Deyu challenged him: "Supervising Censor is not a fine post—how so?"
translations.idiomatic: Deyu challenged him: "Supervising Censor is not a fine post—how so?

sentences.zh: 宗閔大沮，不得對。

translations.literal: Zongmin was greatly discouraged and could not reply.
translations.idiomatic: Zongmin was greatly discouraged and could not reply.

sentences.zh: 俄以同平章事為山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: Before long he was sent out as Director of the Chancellery and military governor of Shannan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was sent out as Director of the Chancellery and military governor of Shannan West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 李訓、鄭注始用事，疾德裕，共訾短之。

translations.literal: When Li Xun and Zheng Zhu first came to power they hated Deyu and together slandered him.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Xun and Zheng Zhu first came to power they hated Deyu and together slandered him.

sentences.zh: 乃罷德裕，復召宗閔知政事，進封襄武縣侯，恣肆附托。

translations.literal: Deyu was dismissed and Zongmin was again recalled to manage affairs, advanced and enfeoffed as Marquis of Xiangwu, and indulged in attaching dependents.
translations.idiomatic: Deyu was dismissed and Zongmin was again recalled to manage affairs, advanced and enfeoffed as Marquis of Xiangwu, and indulged in attaching dependents.

sentences.zh: 會虞卿以京兆尹得罪，極言營解，帝怒叱曰：「爾嘗以鄭覃為妖氣，今自為妖耶？」

translations.literal: When Yuqing was implicated as Jingzhao Intendant he spoke at length to defend him; the Emperor angrily rebuked him: "You once called Zheng Tan an evil influence—are you now an evil influence yourself?"
translations.idiomatic: When Yuqing was implicated as Jingzhao Intendant he spoke at length to defend him; the Emperor angrily rebuked him: "You once called Zheng Tan an evil influence—are you now an evil influence yourself?

sentences.zh: 即出為明州刺史，貶處州長史。

translations.literal: He was immediately sent out as Prefect of Mingzhou and demoted to Senior Administrator of Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was immediately sent out as Prefect of Mingzhou and demoted to Senior Administrator of Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 訓、注乃劾：「宗閔異時陰結駙馬都尉沈𥫃、內人宋若憲、宦者韋元素、王踐言等求宰相，且言頃上有疾，密問術家呂華，迎考命曆，曰：'惡十二月。

translations.literal: Xun and Zhu then impeached: "In former times Zongmin secretly allied with Chief Commandant of the Feathered Forest Guard Shen Su, palace woman Song Ruoxian, and eunuchs Wei Yuansu and Wang Jianyan to seek the chancellorship; moreover they said that recently the ruler had been ill and secretly questioned the diviner Lu Hua, who examined the calendar of fate and said: 'The twelfth month is ill-omened.
translations.idiomatic: Xun and Zhu then impeached: "In former times Zongmin secretly allied with Chief Commandant of the Feathered Forest Guard Shen Su, palace woman Song Ruoxian, and eunuchs Wei Yuansu and Wang Jianyan to seek the chancellorship; moreover they said that recently the ruler had been ill and secretly questioned the diviner Lu Hua, who examined the calendar of fate and said: 'The twelfth month is ill-omened.

sentences.zh: '而踐言監軍劍南，受德裕賕，復與宗閔家私。」

translations.literal: And Jianyan supervised the army in Jiannan, accepted Deyu's bribe, and again had private dealings with Zongmin's family."
translations.idiomatic: And Jianyan supervised the army in Jiannan, accepted Deyu's bribe, and again had private dealings with Zongmin's family.

sentences.zh: 乃貶宗閔潮州司戶參軍事，𥫃逐柳州，元素等悉流嶺南，親信並斥。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zongmin was demoted to Army Staff Officer of Chaozhou, Su was exiled to Liuzhou, Yuansu and others were all banished to Lingnan, and close associates were all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Zongmin was demoted to Army Staff Officer of Chaozhou, Su was exiled to Liuzhou, Yuansu and others were all banished to Lingnan, and close associates were all dismissed.

sentences.zh: 時訓、注欲以權市天下，凡不附己者，皆指以二人黨，逐去之。

translations.literal: At the time Xun and Zhu wished to trade power for the realm; whoever did not attach to them was accused as members of the two men's faction and driven away.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Xun and Zhu wished to trade power for the realm; whoever did not attach to them was accused as members of the two men's faction and driven away.

sentences.zh: 人人駭栗，連月雺晦。

translations.literal: Every man was terrified; for months the sky was murky and dark.
translations.idiomatic: Every man was terrified; for months the sky was murky and dark.

sentences.zh: 帝乃詔宗閔、德裕姻家門生故吏，自今一切不問，所以慰安中外。

translations.literal: The Emperor thereupon issued an edict that in-laws, students, and former officials of Zongmin and Deyu from now on would not be questioned at all, in order to comfort court and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor thereupon issued an edict that in-laws, students, and former officials of Zongmin and Deyu from now on would not be questioned at all, in order to comfort court and commoners.

sentences.zh: 嘗歎曰：「去河北賊易，去此朋黨難！」

translations.literal: He once sighed and said: "Removing the Hebei rebels is easy; removing these factions is hard!"
translations.idiomatic: He once sighed and said: "Removing the Hebei rebels is easy; removing these factions is hard!"

sentences.zh: 開成初，幽州刺史元忠、河陽李載義累表論洗，乃徙為衢州司馬。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaicheng, Prefect of Youzhou Yuan Zhong and Heyang's Li Zaiyi repeatedly memorialized to clear him, and he was transferred to Prefectural Militia Vice Commandant of Quzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaicheng, Prefect of Youzhou Yuan Zhong and Heyang's Li Zaiyi repeatedly memorialized to clear him, and he was transferred to Prefectural Militia Vice Commandant of Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 楊嗣復輔政，與宗閔善，欲復用，而畏鄭覃，乃托宦人諷帝。

translations.literal: Yang Sifu assisted in governance and was on good terms with Zongmin and wished to reuse him, but feared Zheng Tan and therefore had a eunuch hint to the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Sifu assisted in governance and was on good terms with Zongmin and wished to reuse him, but feared Zheng Tan and therefore had a eunuch hint to the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 帝因紫宸對覃曰：「朕念宗閔久斥，應授一官。」

translations.literal: The Emperor therefore said to Tan at the Zichen audience: "I think of Zongmin's long banishment and should grant him an office."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor therefore said to Tan at the Zichen audience: "I think of Zongmin's long banishment and should grant him an office.

sentences.zh: 覃曰：「陛下徙令少近則可，若再用，臣請前免。」

translations.literal: Tan said: "If Your Majesty transfers him to something nearer that will do; if he is again employed, your subject requests dismissal beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: Tan said: "If Your Majesty transfers him to something nearer that will do; if he is again employed, your subject requests dismissal beforehand.

sentences.zh: 陳夷行曰：「宗閔之罪，不即死為幸。

translations.literal: Chen Yixing said: "Zongmin's crime— that he was not immediately put to death was his good fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yixing said: "Zongmin's crime— that he was not immediately put to death was his good fortune.

sentences.zh: 寶歷時，李續、張又新等號'八關十六子'，朋比險妄，朝廷幾危。」

translations.literal: In the Baoli era Li Xu, Zhang Youxin, and others were called the 'Eight Passes and Sixteen Sons'—they banded together in dangerous falsehood and the court nearly perished."
translations.idiomatic: In the Baoli era Li Xu, Zhang Youxin, and others were called the 'Eight Passes and Sixteen Sons'—they banded together in dangerous falsehood and the court nearly perished.

sentences.zh: 李玨曰：「此李逢吉罪。

translations.literal: Li Jue said: "This was Li Fengji's crime.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jue said: "This was Li Fengji's crime.

sentences.zh: 今續喪闋，不可不任以官。」

translations.literal: Now Xu has finished mourning and cannot but be given an office.
translations.idiomatic: Now Xu has finished mourning and must be given an office.

sentences.zh: 夷行曰：「不然，舜逐四凶天下治，朝廷何惜數憸人，使亂紀綱？」

translations.literal: Yixing said: "Not so—when Shun drove out the four evil ones all under heaven was governed; why should the court spare several crafty men and let them disorder discipline?
translations.idiomatic: Yixing said: "Not so—when Shun drove out the four evil ones all under heaven was governed; why should the court spare several crafty men and let them disorder discipline?

sentences.zh: 嗣復曰：「事當適宜，不可以憎愛奪。」

translations.literal: Sifu said: "Matters should suit what is fitting—love and hate must not decide.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu said: "Matters should suit what is fitting—love and hate must not decide.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「州刺史可乎？」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Prefect of a province will do?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Prefect of a province will do?

sentences.zh: 覃請授洪州別駕。

translations.literal: Tan requested appointment as Vice Prefect of Hongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Tan requested appointment as Vice Prefect of Hongzhou.

sentences.zh: 夷行曰：「宗閔始庇鄭注，階其禍，幾覆國。」

translations.literal: Yixing said: "Zongmin at first sheltered Zheng Zhu and shared in his calamity, nearly overturning the state.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing said: "Zongmin at first sheltered Zheng Zhu and shared in his calamity, nearly overturning the state.

sentences.zh: 嗣復曰：「陛下向欲官鄭注，而宗閔不奉詔，尚當記之。」

translations.literal: Sifu said: "Your Majesty formerly wished to appoint Zheng Zhu to office and Zongmin did not obey the edict—that should still be remembered.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu said: "Your Majesty formerly wished to appoint Zheng Zhu to office and Zongmin did not obey the edict—that should still be remembered.

sentences.zh: 覃質曰：「嗣復党宗閔者，彼其惡似李林甫。」

translations.literal: Tan challenged: "Sifu is a partisan of Zongmin; his evil resembles Li Linfu.
translations.idiomatic: Tan challenged: "Sifu is a partisan of Zongmin; his evil resembles Li Linfu.

sentences.zh: 嗣復曰：「覃言過矣。

translations.literal: Sifu said: "Tan's words go too far.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu said: "Tan's words go too far.

sentences.zh: 林甫妒賢忌功，夷滅十余族，宗閔固無之。

translations.literal: Linfu was jealous of the worthy and hated merit, extinguishing more than ten clans—Zongmin certainly had nothing like that.
translations.idiomatic: Linfu was jealous of the worthy and hated merit, extinguishing more than ten clans—Zongmin certainly had nothing like that.

sentences.zh: 始，宗閔與德裕俱得罪，德裕再徙鎮，而宗閔故在貶地。

translations.literal: At first Zongmin and Deyu were both punished; Deyu was again transferred to a command while Zongmin remained in banishment.
translations.idiomatic: At first Zongmin and Deyu were both punished; Deyu was again transferred to a command while Zongmin remained in banishment.

sentences.zh: 夫懲勸宜一，不可謂黨。」

translations.literal: Punishment and encouragement should be one—this cannot be called faction.
translations.idiomatic: Punishment and encouragement should be one—this cannot be called faction.

sentences.zh: 因折覃曰：「比殷侑為韓益求官，臣以其昔坐贓，不許。

translations.literal: He then refuted Tan: "Recently when Yin You sought an office for Han Yi, your subject because Yi had formerly been implicated in bribery did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: He then refuted Tan: "Recently when Yin You sought an office for Han Yi, your subject because Yi had formerly been implicated in bribery did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 覃托臣勿論，是豈不為黨乎？」

translations.literal: Tan asked your subject not to discuss it—is that not also faction?"
translations.idiomatic: Tan asked your subject not to discuss it—is that not also faction?

sentences.zh: 遂擢宗閔杭州刺史。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zongmin was promoted to Prefect of Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Zongmin was promoted to Prefect of Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 遷太子賓客，分司東都。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Mentor to the Crown Prince, branch office of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Mentor to the Crown Prince, branch office of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 既而覃、夷行去位，嗣復謀引宗閔復輔政，未及而文宗崩。

translations.literal: Before long Tan and Yixing left office; Sifu plotted to bring Zongmin back to assist in governance but before it happened Wenzong died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Tan and Yixing left office; Sifu plotted to bring Zongmin back to assist in governance but before it happened Wenzong died.

sentences.zh: 會昌中，劉稹以澤潞叛，德裕建言宗閔素厚從諫，今上黨近東都，乃拜宗閔湖州刺史。

translations.literal: In the Huichang era, when Liu Zhen rebelled at Zelu, Deyu submitted that Zongmin had long been close to Congjian; now Shangdang was near the Eastern Capital, and Zongmin was appointed Prefect of Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Huichang era, when Liu Zhen rebelled at Zelu, Deyu submitted that Zongmin had long been close to Congjian; now Shangdang was near the Eastern Capital, and Zongmin was appointed Prefect of Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 稹敗，得交通狀，貶漳州長史，流封州。

translations.literal: When Zhen was defeated, evidence of correspondence was obtained; he was demoted to Senior Administrator of Zhangzhou and exiled to Fengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhen was defeated, evidence of correspondence was obtained; he was demoted to Senior Administrator of Zhangzhou and exiled to Fengzhou.

sentences.zh: 宣宗即位，徙柳州司馬，卒。

translations.literal: When Xuanzong took the throne he was transferred to Prefectural Militia Vice Commandant of Liuzhou and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuanzong took the throne he was transferred to Prefectural Militia Vice Commandant of Liuzhou and died.

sentences.zh: 宗閔性機警，始有當世令名，既浸貴，喜權勢。

translations.literal: Zongmin was alert by nature; at first he had a fine name in his age; once he gradually rose in rank he delighted in power.
translations.idiomatic: Zongmin was alert by nature; at first he had a fine name in his age; once he gradually rose in rank he delighted in power.

sentences.zh: 初為裴度引拔，後度薦德裕可為相，宗閔遂與為怨。

translations.literal: At first he was promoted by Pei Du; afterward Du recommended Deyu as fit for chancellor, and Zongmin thereupon became his enemy.
translations.idiomatic: At first he was promoted by Pei Du; afterward Du recommended Deyu as fit for chancellor, and Zongmin thereupon became his enemy.

sentences.zh: 韓愈為作《南山》、《猛虎行》規之。

translations.literal: Han Yu wrote "Mount South" and "Song of the Fierce Tiger" to admonish him.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu wrote "Mount South" and "Song of the Fierce Tiger" to admonish him.

sentences.zh: 而宗閔崇私黨，薰熾中外，卒以是敗。

translations.literal: But Zongmin honored private factions, which blazed within and without, and ultimately failed on that account.
translations.idiomatic: But Zongmin honored private factions, which blazed within and without, and ultimately failed on that account.

sentences.zh: 子琨、瓚，皆擢進士。

translations.literal: His sons Kun and Zan both passed the jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Kun and Zan both passed the jinshi.

sentences.zh: 令狐綯作相，而瓚以知制誥曆翰林學士。

translations.literal: When Linghu Tao became chancellor, Zan served as Drafting Secretary and successively as Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: When Linghu Tao became chancellor, Zan served as Drafting Secretary and successively as Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 綯罷，亦為桂管觀察使。

translations.literal: When Tao was dismissed, Zan also became Guiguan Observation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Tao was dismissed, Zan also became Guiguan Observation Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 不善禦軍，為士卒所逐，貶死。

translations.literal: He was poor at controlling troops and was driven out by soldiers and demoted to death.
translations.idiomatic: He was poor at controlling troops and was driven out by soldiers and demoted to death.

sentences.zh: 宗閔弟宗冉，其子湯，累官京兆尹，黃巢陷長安，殺之。

translations.literal: Zongmin's younger brother Zongran's son Tang held successive posts as Jingzhao Intendant; when Huang Chao took Chang'an he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Zongmin's younger brother Zongran's son Tang held successive posts as Jingzhao Intendant; when Huang Chao took Chang'an he was killed.

sentences.zh: 楊嗣復楊嗣復，字繼之。

translations.literal: Yang Sifu Yang Sifu, styled Jizhi.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Sifu, styled Jizhi.

sentences.zh: 父於陵，始見識於浙西觀察使韓滉，妻以其女。

translations.literal: His father Yuling was first recognized by Zhexi Observation Commissioner Han Huang, who gave him his daughter in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: His father Yuling was first recognized by Zhexi Observation Commissioner Han Huang, who gave him his daughter in marriage.

sentences.zh: 歸謂妻曰：「吾閱人多矣，後貴且壽無若生者，有子必位宰相。」

translations.literal: Returning he said to his wife: "I have seen many men; none later honored, long-lived, and prosperous like the one born—if he has a son he will surely reach chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Returning he said to his wife: "I have seen many men; none later honored, long-lived, and prosperous like the one born—if he has a son he will surely reach chancellor.

sentences.zh: 既而生嗣復，滉撫其頂曰：「名與位皆逾其父，楊氏之慶也。」

translations.literal: When Sifu was born, Huang stroked his crown and said: "His name and office both exceed his father's—the Yang family's good fortune.
translations.idiomatic: When Sifu was born, Huang stroked his crown and said: "His name and office both exceed his father's—the Yang family's good fortune.

sentences.zh: 因字曰慶門。

translations.literal: He was therefore styled Gate of Celebration.
translations.idiomatic: He was therefore styled Gate of Celebration.

sentences.zh: 八歲知屬文，後擢進士、博學宏辭，與裴度、柳公綽皆為武元衡所知，表署劍南幕府。

translations.literal: At eight he knew composition; later he passed the jinshi and Broad Learning and Eloquent Prose examinations; together with Pei Du and Liu Gongchuo he was known to Wu Yuanheng and was recruited to the Jiannan staff.
translations.idiomatic: At eight he knew composition; later he passed the jinshi and Broad Learning and Eloquent Prose examinations; together with Pei Du and Liu Gongchuo he was known to Wu Yuanheng and was recruited to the Jiannan staff.

sentences.zh: 進右拾遺，直史館。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Right Reminder and served in the Historiography Institute.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Right Reminder and served in the Historiography Institute.

sentences.zh: 尤善禮家學，改太常博士，再遷禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: He was especially versed in ritualist learning, changed to Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and was twice transferred to Vice Director of the Board of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was especially versed in ritualist learning, changed to Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and was twice transferred to Vice Director of the Board of Rites.

sentences.zh: 時於陵為戶部侍郎，嗣復避同省，換他官，有詔：「同司，親大功以上，非聯判句檢官長，皆勿避。

translations.literal: At the time Yuling was Vice Minister of Revenue; Sifu avoided serving in the same ministry and exchanged for another office; an edict said: "In the same ministry, for relatives within great mourning or closer, unless jointly judging or inspecting or serving as section chief, all need not avoid.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Yuling was Vice Minister of Revenue; Sifu avoided serving in the same ministry and exchanged for another office; an edict said: "In the same ministry, for relatives within great mourning or closer, unless jointly judging or inspecting or serving as section chief, all need not avoid.

sentences.zh: 官同職異，雖父子兄弟無嫌。」

translations.literal: Offices the same but duties different—even father and son and brothers have no cause for suspicion."
translations.idiomatic: Offices the same but duties different—even father and son and brothers have no cause for suspicion.

sentences.zh: 遷累中書舍人。

translations.literal: He was transferred through accumulated appointments to Drafting Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred through accumulated appointments to Drafting Secretary.

sentences.zh: 嗣復與牛僧孺、李宗閔雅相善，二人輔政，引之，然不欲越父當國，故權知禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: Sifu was on excellent terms with Niu Sengru and Li Zongmin; when the two assisted in governance they brought him in, yet did not wish to surpass his father in holding power, and therefore he was temporarily put in charge as Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu was on excellent terms with Niu Sengru and Li Zongmin; when the two assisted in governance they brought him in, yet did not wish to surpass his father in holding power, and therefore he was temporarily put in charge as Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 凡二期，得士六十八人，多顯官。

translations.literal: For two terms in all he obtained sixty-eight scholars, many of whom became prominent officials.
translations.idiomatic: For two terms in all he obtained sixty-eight scholars, many of whom became prominent officials.

sentences.zh: 文宗嗣位，進戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: When Wenzong succeeded to the throne he was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When Wenzong succeeded to the throne he was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 於陵老，求侍不許。

translations.literal: Yuling was old and requested attendance but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Yuling was old and requested attendance but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 喪除，擢尚書左丞。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was promoted to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was promoted to Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 太和中，宗閔罷，嗣復出為劍南東川節度使。

translations.literal: In the Taihe era, when Zongmin was dismissed, Sifu went out as military governor of Jiannan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taihe era, when Zongmin was dismissed, Sifu went out as military governor of Jiannan East Circuit.

sentences.zh: 宗閔復相，徙西川。

translations.literal: When Zongmin again became chancellor he was transferred to West Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: When Zongmin again became chancellor he was transferred to West Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 開成初，以戶部侍郎召，領諸道鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaicheng he was summoned as Vice Minister of Revenue and put in charge of the Salt and Iron Transport of all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Kaicheng he was summoned as Vice Minister of Revenue and put in charge of the Salt and Iron Transport of all circuits.

sentences.zh: 俄與李玨並拜同中書門下平章事，弘農縣伯，仍領鹽鐵。

translations.literal: Before long he and Li Jue were together invested as Directors of the Chancellery, Baron of Hongnong County, still overseeing salt and iron.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he and Li Jue were together invested as Directors of the Chancellery, Baron of Hongnong County, still overseeing salt and iron.

sentences.zh: 後紫宸奏事，嗣復為帝言：「陸洿屏居民間，而上書論兵，可勸以官。」

translations.literal: Later at Zichen when presenting affairs, Sifu said to the Emperor: "Lu Ze lives hidden among the people yet memorializes on military affairs—he can be encouraged with an office.
translations.idiomatic: Later at Zichen when presenting affairs, Sifu said to the Emperor: "Lu Ze lives hidden among the people yet memorializes on military affairs—he can be encouraged with an office.

sentences.zh: 玨趣和曰：「土多趨競，能獎洿，貪夫廉矣。

translations.literal: Jue hastened to agree: "Gentry mostly rush for advancement; if Ze can be rewarded, the greedy will become honest.
translations.idiomatic: Jue hastened to agree: "Gentry mostly rush for advancement; if Ze can be rewarded, the greedy will become honest.

sentences.zh: 比竇洵直以論事見賞，天下釋然，況官洿耶！」

translations.literal: Recently Dou Xunzhi was rewarded for speaking on affairs and all under heaven were relieved—how much more if Ze were given an office!"
translations.idiomatic: Recently Dou Xunzhi was rewarded for speaking on affairs and all under heaven were relieved—how much more if Ze were given an office!

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「朕賞洵直，褒其心爾。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "I rewarded Xunzhi to praise his heart.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "I rewarded Xunzhi to praise his heart.

sentences.zh: 鄭覃不平曰：「彼苞藏固未易知。」

translations.literal: Tan was displeased and said: "What he harbors is certainly not easy to know.
translations.idiomatic: Tan was displeased and said: "What he harbors is certainly not easy to know.

sentences.zh: 嗣復曰：「洵直無邪，臣知之。」

translations.literal: Sifu said: "Xunzhi is without evil—I know him.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu said: "Xunzhi is without evil—I know him.

sentences.zh: 覃曰：「陛下當察朋黨。」

translations.literal: Tan said: "Your Majesty should examine factions.
translations.idiomatic: Tan said: "Your Majesty should examine factions.

sentences.zh: 嗣復曰：「覃疑臣黨，臣應免。」

translations.literal: Sifu said: "Tan suspects your subject of faction—your subject should be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu said: "Tan suspects your subject of faction—your subject should be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 即再拜祈罷。

translations.literal: He bowed again and begged to resign.
translations.idiomatic: He bowed again and begged to resign.

sentences.zh: 玨見言切，繆曰：「朋黨固少弭。」

translations.literal: Jue, seeing the words were sharp, falsely said: "Factions are indeed somewhat stilled.
translations.idiomatic: Jue, seeing the words were sharp, falsely said: "Factions are indeed somewhat stilled.

sentences.zh: 覃曰：「附離復生。」

translations.literal: Tan said: "Those who attach themselves will spring up again.
translations.idiomatic: Tan said: "Those who attach themselves will spring up again.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「向所謂黨與，不已盡乎？」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Have not the so-called factions already been exhausted?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Have not the so-called factions already been exhausted?

sentences.zh: 覃曰：「楊漢公、張又新、李續故在。」

translations.literal: Tan said: "Yang Hangong, Zhang Youxin, and Li Xu are still there.
translations.idiomatic: Tan said: "Yang Hangong, Zhang Youxin, and Li Xu are still there.

sentences.zh: 玨乃陳邊事，欲絕其語。

translations.literal: Jue then set forth frontier affairs, wishing to cut off the discussion.
translations.idiomatic: Jue then set forth frontier affairs, wishing to cut off the discussion.

sentences.zh: 覃曰：「論邊事安危，臣不如玨；

translations.literal: Tan said: "In discussing whether frontier affairs are safe or perilous, your subject is not Jue's equal;
translations.idiomatic: Tan said: "In discussing whether frontier affairs are safe or perilous, your subject is not Jue's equal;

sentences.zh: 嫉朋比，玨不如臣。」

translations.literal: in hating factional attachment, Jue is not your subject's equal.
translations.idiomatic: in hating factional attachment, Jue is not your subject's equal.

sentences.zh: 嗣復曰：「臣聞左右佩劍，彼此相笑，未知覃果謂誰為朋黨邪？」

translations.literal: Sifu said: "Your subject has heard that those at left and right wear swords and laugh at one another—I do not know whom Tan considers faction members.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu said: "Your subject has heard that those at left and right wear swords and laugh at one another—I do not know whom Tan considers faction members.

sentences.zh: 因當香案頓首曰：「臣位宰相，不能進賢退不肖，以朋黨獲譏，非所以重朝廷。」

translations.literal: He then kowtowed at the incense table and said: "Your subject holds the post of chancellor yet cannot advance the worthy and retire the unfit, and is reviled for faction—this is not how to weight the court.
translations.idiomatic: He then kowtowed at the incense table and said: "Your subject holds the post of chancellor yet cannot advance the worthy and retire the unfit, and is reviled for faction—this is not how to weight the court.

sentences.zh: 固乞罷，帝方委以政，故尉安之。

translations.literal: He firmly begged to resign; the Emperor was then entrusting him with affairs and therefore comforted him.
translations.idiomatic: He firmly begged to resign; the Emperor was then entrusting him with affairs and therefore comforted him.

sentences.zh: 它日，帝問：「符讖可信乎？

translations.literal: On another day the Emperor asked: "Are omens and prophecies trustworthy?
translations.idiomatic: On another day the Emperor asked: "Are omens and prophecies trustworthy?

sentences.zh: 何從而生？」

translations.literal: Whence do they arise?
translations.idiomatic: Whence do they arise?

sentences.zh: 嗣復曰：「漢光武以讖決事，隋文帝亦喜之，故其書蔓天下。

translations.literal: Sifu said: "Emperor Guangwu of Han decided affairs by omens; Emperor Wen of Sui also delighted in them; therefore their books spread throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu said: "Emperor Guangwu of Han decided affairs by omens; Emperor Wen of Sui also delighted in them; therefore their books spread throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 班彪《王命論》有所引述，特以止賊亂，非重之也。」

translations.literal: Ban Biao's "Discourse on the Mandate of Kingship" cites them, but only to stop bandit disorder—not to weight them.
translations.idiomatic: Ban Biao's "Discourse on the Mandate of Kingship" cites them, but only to stop bandit disorder—not to weight them.

sentences.zh: 玨曰：「治亂宜直推人事耳。」

translations.literal: Jue said: "Order and disorder should be judged straightforwardly by human affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jue said: "Order and disorder should be judged straightforwardly by human affairs.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「然。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "So it is.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "So it is.

sentences.zh: 又問：「天后時有起布衣為宰相者，果可用乎？」

translations.literal: He again asked: "In Empress Wu's time commoners were raised to chancellor—can they truly be employed?
translations.idiomatic: He again asked: "In Empress Wu's time commoners were raised to chancellor—can they truly be employed?

sentences.zh: 嗣復曰：「天后重用刑，輕用官，自為之計耳。

translations.literal: Sifu said: "Empress Wu heavily used punishments and lightly used offices—that was calculation for herself.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu said: "Empress Wu heavily used punishments and lightly used offices—that was calculation for herself.

sentences.zh: 必責能否，要待曆試乃可。」

translations.literal: If ability and inability must be demanded, one must wait until trial through experience."
translations.idiomatic: If ability and inability must be demanded, one must wait until trial through experience."

sentences.zh: 是時延英訪對，史官不及知。

translations.literal: At the time at Yanying question-and-answer the historiographers did not reach in time to know.
translations.idiomatic: At the time at Yanying question-and-answer the historiographers did not reach in time to know.

sentences.zh: 嗣復建言：「故事，正衙，起居注在前；

translations.literal: Sifu submitted: "By precedent, at the main court the Daily Record precedes;
translations.idiomatic: Sifu submitted: "By precedent, at the main court the Daily Record precedes;

sentences.zh: 便坐，無所紀錄。

translations.literal: at informal seating nothing is recorded.
translations.idiomatic: at informal seating nothing is recorded.

sentences.zh: 姚璹、趙憬皆請置時政記，不能行。

translations.literal: Yao Shuai and Zhao Jing both requested establishing a record of current policy but could not carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Shuai and Zhao Jing both requested establishing a record of current policy but could not carry it out.

sentences.zh: 臣請延英對宰相語關道德刑政者，委中書門下直日紀錄，月付史官。」

translations.literal: Your subject requests that at Yanying, when chancellors speak on matters relating to virtue, punishments, and government, the Secretariat and Chancellery duty officer of the day be ordered to record them and monthly deliver them to the historiographers.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject requests that at Yanying, when chancellors speak on matters relating to virtue, punishments, and government, the Secretariat and Chancellery duty officer of the day be ordered to record them and monthly deliver them to the historiographers.

sentences.zh: 它宰相議不同，止。

translations.literal: The other chancellors debated differently and it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The other chancellors debated differently and it stopped.

sentences.zh: 久之，帝又問：「延英政事，孰當記之？」

translations.literal: After a long time the Emperor again asked: "Who should record Yanying affairs?
translations.idiomatic: After a long time the Emperor again asked: "Who should record Yanying affairs?

sentences.zh: 玨監修國史，對曰：「臣之職也。」

translations.literal: Jue, supervising compilation of the national history, replied: "That is your subject's duty.
translations.idiomatic: Jue, supervising compilation of the national history, replied: "That is your subject's duty.

sentences.zh: 陳夷行曰：「宰相所錄，恐掩蔽聖德，自盜美名。

translations.literal: Yixing said: "What chancellors record may cover the sage's virtue and steal fine reputation for themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Yixing said: "What chancellors record may cover the sage's virtue and steal fine reputation for themselves.

sentences.zh: 臣向言不欲威權在下者，此也。」

translations.literal: Your subject spoke earlier of not wishing authority below—this is it.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject spoke earlier of not wishing authority below—this is it.

sentences.zh: 玨曰：「夷行疑宰相賣威權，貨刑賞。

translations.literal: Jue said: "Yixing suspects chancellors of selling authority and trading punishments and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Jue said: "Yixing suspects chancellors of selling authority and trading punishments and rewards.

sentences.zh: 不然，何自居位而為此言邪？

translations.literal: If not, why hold office yet speak thus?
translations.idiomatic: If not, why hold office yet speak thus?

sentences.zh: 臣得罷為幸。」

translations.literal: Your subject would be fortunate to be dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject would be fortunate to be dismissed.

sentences.zh: 覃曰：「陛下開成初政甚善，三年後，日不逮前。」

translations.literal: Tan said: "Your Majesty's governance at the beginning of Kaicheng was very good; after three years each day did not match the former.
translations.idiomatic: Tan said: "Your Majesty's governance at the beginning of Kaicheng was very good; after three years each day did not match the former.

sentences.zh: 嗣復曰：「開成初，覃、夷行當國，三年後，臣與李玨同進。

translations.literal: Sifu said: "At the beginning of Kaicheng Tan and Yixing held power; after three years your subject and Li Jue advanced together.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu said: "At the beginning of Kaicheng Tan and Yixing held power; after three years your subject and Li Jue advanced together.

sentences.zh: 臣不能悉心奉職，使政事日不逮前，臣之罪也。

translations.literal: Your subject cannot wholeheartedly perform his duty and make governance each day fall short of the former—that is your subject's crime.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject cannot wholeheartedly perform his duty and make governance each day fall short of the former—that is your subject's crime.

sentences.zh: 縱陛下不忍加誅，當自殄滅。」

translations.literal: Even if Your Majesty cannot bear to add execution, your subject should destroy himself.
translations.idiomatic: Even if Your Majesty cannot bear to add execution, your subject should destroy himself.

sentences.zh: 即叩頭請從此辭，不敢更至中書，乃趨出。

translations.literal: He kowtowed and requested from this to resign and dared not again reach the Secretariat; he then hurried out.
translations.idiomatic: He kowtowed and requested from this to resign and dared not again reach the Secretariat; he then hurried out.

sentences.zh: 帝使使者召還，曰：「覃言失，何及此邪？」

translations.literal: The Emperor sent an envoy to summon him back and said: "Tan's words were wrong—why go this far?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor sent an envoy to summon him back and said: "Tan's words were wrong—why go this far?

sentences.zh: 覃起謝曰：「臣愚不知忌諱，近事雖善，猶未盡公。

translations.literal: Tan rose and apologized: "Your subject was foolish and did not know taboo; though recent affairs were good, they still did not fully serve the public.
translations.idiomatic: Tan rose and apologized: "Your subject was foolish and did not know taboo; though recent affairs were good, they still did not fully serve the public.

sentences.zh: 臣非專斥嗣復，而遽求去，乃不使臣言耳。」

translations.literal: Your subject did not specially reject Sifu; he abruptly sought to leave—that is not letting your subject speak.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject did not specially reject Sifu; he abruptly sought to leave—that is not letting your subject speak.

sentences.zh: 嗣復曰：「陛下月費俸稟數十萬，時新異賜必先及，將責臣輔聖功，求至治也。

translations.literal: Sifu said: "Your Majesty monthly spends several hundred thousand in salary and stipends; timely new and special grants always reach your subject first—the intent is to charge your subject to assist the sage's achievement and seek utmost governance.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu said: "Your Majesty monthly spends several hundred thousand in salary and stipends; timely new and special grants always reach your subject first—the intent is to charge your subject to assist the sage's achievement and seek utmost governance.

sentences.zh: 使不及初，豈臣當死，累陛下之德，奈何？

translations.literal: If it does not match the beginning, is your subject fit to die and burden Your Majesty's virtue—how can this be?
translations.idiomatic: If it does not match the beginning, is your subject fit to die and burden Your Majesty's virtue—how can this be?

sentences.zh: 惟陛下別求賢以自輔。」

translations.literal: I only wish Your Majesty separately seek the worthy to assist yourself.
translations.idiomatic: I only wish Your Majesty separately seek the worthy to assist yourself.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「覃偶及之，奚執咎？」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Tan touched on it by chance—why hold a grudge?
