translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Tan touched on it by chance—why hold a grudge?

sentences.zh: 嗣復闔門不肯起，帝乃免覃、夷行相，而嗣復專天下事。

translations.literal: Sifu closed his gate and refused to rise; the Emperor then dismissed Tan and Yixing from the chancellorship, and Sifu alone managed affairs under heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu closed his gate and refused to rise; the Emperor then dismissed Tan and Yixing from the chancellorship, and Sifu alone managed affairs under heaven.

sentences.zh: 進門下侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 建言：「使府官屬多，宜省。」

translations.literal: He submitted: "Staff of commissioner offices are many and should be reduced.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted: "Staff of commissioner offices are many and should be reduced.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「無反滯才乎？」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Will no talented men be blocked?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Will no talented men be blocked?

sentences.zh: 對曰：「才者自異，汰去粃滓者，菁華乃出。」

translations.literal: He replied: "The talented are naturally distinct; sift out the chaff and the essence emerges.
translations.idiomatic: He replied: "The talented are naturally distinct; sift out the chaff and the essence emerges.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「昔蕭復乘政，難言者必言，卿其志之！」

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "In former times when Xiao Fu held power, whatever was hard to speak he spoke—take that as your aim!"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "In former times when Xiao Fu held power, whatever was hard to speak he spoke—take that as your aim!"

sentences.zh: 未幾，帝崩，中尉仇士良廢遺詔，立武宗。

translations.literal: Before long the Emperor died; Army Supervising Eunuch Qiu Shiliang set aside the testamentary edict and installed Wuzong.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Emperor died; Army Supervising Eunuch Qiu Shiliang set aside the testamentary edict and installed Wuzong.

sentences.zh: 帝之立，非宰相意，故內薄執政臣，不加禮，自用李德裕而罷嗣復為吏部尚書，出為湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: The Emperor's installation was not the chancellors' intent; therefore within he looked coldly on the governing ministers, did not add courtesy, himself employed Li Deyu, and dismissed Sifu as Minister of Personnel, sending him out as Hunan Observation Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's installation was not the chancellors' intent; therefore within he looked coldly on the governing ministers, did not add courtesy, himself employed Li Deyu, and dismissed Sifu as Minister of Personnel, sending him out as Hunan Observation Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 會誅薛季棱、劉弘逸，中人多言嘗附嗣復、玨，不利於陛下。

translations.literal: When Xue Jiling and Liu Hongyi were executed, many within said they had once attached to Sifu and Jue to the Emperor's disadvantage.
translations.idiomatic: When Xue Jiling and Liu Hongyi were executed, many within said they had once attached to Sifu and Jue to the Emperor's disadvantage.

sentences.zh: 帝剛急，即詔中使分道誅嗣復等，德裕與崔鄆、崔珙等詣延英言：「故事，大臣非惡狀明白，未有誅死者。

translations.literal: The Emperor was harsh and impatient; he immediately issued an edict inner envoys to execute Sifu and others by separate routes; Deyu together with Cui Ye, Cui Gong, and others went to Yanying and said: "By precedent, great ministers are not executed unless evil is clearly established.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was harsh and impatient; he immediately issued an edict inner envoys to execute Sifu and others by separate routes; Deyu together with Cui Ye, Cui Gong, and others went to Yanying and said: "By precedent, great ministers are not executed unless evil is clearly established.

sentences.zh: 昔太宗、玄宗、德宗三帝，皆嘗用重刑，後無不悔，願徐思其宜，使天下知盛德有所容，不欲人以為冤。」

translations.literal: Formerly Emperors Taizong, Xuanzong, and Dezong all once used heavy punishments and afterward none failed to regret it; I wish it be pondered slowly for fitness, so all under heaven know that great virtue has room and does not wish men to think it injustice.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Emperors Taizong, Xuanzong, and Dezong all once used heavy punishments and afterward none failed to regret it; I wish it be pondered slowly for fitness, so all under heaven know that great virtue has room and does not wish men to think it injustice.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「朕纘嗣之際，宰相何嘗比數！

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "At the time I succeeded, when did the chancellors ever count for comparison!
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "At the time I succeeded, when did the chancellors ever count for comparison!

sentences.zh: 且玨等各有附會，若玨、季棱屬陳王，猶是先帝意。

translations.literal: Moreover Jue and others each had attachments; if Jue and Jiling belonged to Prince Chen, that was still the Former Emperor's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Jue and others each had attachments; if Jue and Jiling belonged to Prince Chen, that was still the Former Emperor's intent.

sentences.zh: 如嗣復、弘逸屬安王，乃內為楊妃謀。

translations.literal: But Sifu and Hongyi belonged to Prince An—that was scheming within for Consort Yang.
translations.idiomatic: But Sifu and Hongyi belonged to Prince An—that was scheming within for Consort Yang.

sentences.zh: 且其所紿書曰：'姑何不斅天后？

translations.literal: Moreover the deceitful letter said: 'Why does the aunt not emulate Empress Wu?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the deceitful letter said: 'Why does the aunt not emulate Empress Wu?

sentences.zh: '」德裕曰：「飛語難辨。」

translations.literal: Deyu said: "Flying rumors are hard to distinguish.
translations.idiomatic: Deyu said: "Flying rumors are hard to distinguish.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「妃昔有疾，先帝許其弟入侍，得通其謀。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "The consort was once ill; the Former Emperor permitted her brother to enter attendance and he could communicate their plot.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "The consort was once ill; the Former Emperor permitted her brother to enter attendance and he could communicate their plot.

sentences.zh: 禁中證左尤具，我不欲暴於外。

translations.literal: Evidence within the palace is especially complete—I do not wish to expose it outside.
translations.idiomatic: Evidence within the palace is especially complete—I do not wish to expose it outside.

sentences.zh: 使安王立，肯容我耶？」

translations.literal: If Prince An were established, would he have tolerated me?"
translations.idiomatic: If Prince An were established, would he have tolerated me?

sentences.zh: 言畢戚然，乃曰：「為卿赦之！」

translations.literal: When he finished he was sorrowful and said: "For your sake I pardon them!
translations.idiomatic: When he finished he was sorrowful and said: "For your sake I pardon them!

sentences.zh: 因追使者還，貶嗣復潮州刺史。

translations.literal: He thereupon recalled the envoys and demoted Sifu to Prefect of Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon recalled the envoys and demoted Sifu to Prefect of Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 宣宗立，起為江州刺史。

translations.literal: When Xuanzong took the throne he was raised to Prefect of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuanzong took the throne he was raised to Prefect of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書召，道岳州卒，年六十六，贈尚書左僕射，諡曰孝穆。

translations.literal: Summoned as Minister of Personnel, he died on the road at Yuezhou at age sixty-six and was posthumously enfeoffed as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with the posthumous name Xiaomu.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned as Minister of Personnel, he died on the road at Yuezhou at age sixty-six and was posthumously enfeoffed as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs with the posthumous name Xiaomu.

sentences.zh: 嗣復領貢舉時，於陵自洛入朝，乃率門生出迎，置酒第中，於陵坐堂上，嗣復與諸生坐兩序。

translations.literal: When Sifu ran the examination, Yuling entered court from Luoyang and led his students out to welcome him, setting wine in his residence; Yuling sat in the hall and Sifu and the students sat in the two wings.
translations.idiomatic: When Sifu ran the examination, Yuling entered court from Luoyang and led his students out to welcome him, setting wine in his residence; Yuling sat in the hall and Sifu and the students sat in the two wings.

sentences.zh: 始於陵在考功，擢浙東觀察使李師稷及第，時亦在焉。

translations.literal: At first when Yuling was in the Board of Merit he selected Zhedong Observation Commissioner Li Shiji on the degree list, and at the time he too was present.
translations.idiomatic: At first when Yuling was in the Board of Merit he selected Zhedong Observation Commissioner Li Shiji on the degree list, and at the time he too was present.

sentences.zh: 人謂楊氏上下門生，世以為美。

translations.literal: People called them teacher and students of the Yang house above and below—the age considered it beautiful.
translations.idiomatic: People called them teacher and students of the Yang house above and below—the age considered it beautiful.

sentences.zh: 嗣復五子，其顯者：授、損。

translations.literal: Sifu had five sons; the prominent ones were Shou and Sun.
translations.idiomatic: Sifu had five sons; the prominent ones were Shou and Sun.

sentences.zh: 子 授授，字得符，于昆弟最賢。

translations.literal: His son Shou, styled Defu, was the most worthy among his brothers.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shou, styled Defu, was the most worthy among his brothers.

sentences.zh: 由進士第遷累戶部侍郎，以母病求為秘書監。

translations.literal: Passing the jinshi he was transferred through accumulated appointments to Vice Minister of Revenue and requested to be Director of the Secretariat on account of his mother's illness.
translations.idiomatic: Passing the jinshi he was transferred through accumulated appointments to Vice Minister of Revenue and requested to be Director of the Secretariat on account of his mother's illness.

sentences.zh: 後以刑部尚書從昭宗幸華，徙太子少保，卒，贈尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: Later he followed Zhaozong to Hua, was transferred to Junior Guardian to the Crown Prince, and died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Later he followed Zhaozong to Hua, was transferred to Junior Guardian to the Crown Prince, and died; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 子 煚子煚，字公隱，累擢左拾遺。

translations.literal: His son Jiong, styled Gongyin, was promoted through accumulated appointments to Left Reminder.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jiong, styled Gongyin, was promoted through accumulated appointments to Left Reminder.

sentences.zh: 昭宗初立，數遊宴，上疏極諫。

translations.literal: When Zhaozong first took the throne he frequently toured and feasted; Jiong submitted a memorial remonstrating sharply.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhaozong first took the throne he frequently toured and feasted; Jiong submitted a memorial remonstrating sharply.

sentences.zh: 曆戶部員外郎。

translations.literal: He successively served as Vice Director of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as Vice Director of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 崔胤招硃全忠入京師，煚挈族客湖南。

translations.literal: When Cui Yin recruited Zhu Quanzhong into the capital, Jiong took his clan as guest to Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: When Cui Yin recruited Zhu Quanzhong into the capital, Jiong took his clan as guest to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 終諫議大夫。

translations.literal: He ended as Remonstrance Officer.
translations.idiomatic: He ended as Remonstrance Officer.

sentences.zh: 子 損損，字子默，繇廕補藍田尉，至殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: His son Sun, styled Zimo, entered office by yin privilege as Lantian Assistant Magistrate and reached Palace Censor.
translations.idiomatic: His son Sun, styled Zimo, entered office by yin privilege as Lantian Assistant Magistrate and reached Palace Censor.

sentences.zh: 家新昌裏，與路岩第接。

translations.literal: The family lived in Xinchang Lane, adjoining the residence of Lu Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The family lived in Xinchang Lane, adjoining the residence of Lu Yan.

sentences.zh: 岩方為相，欲易其廄以廣第。

translations.literal: Yan was then chancellor and wished to exchange their stable to enlarge his residence.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was then chancellor and wished to exchange their stable to enlarge his residence.

sentences.zh: 損族仕者十餘人，議曰：「家世盛衰，系權者喜怒，不可拒。」

translations.literal: More than ten clansmen held office; they debated: "A family's rise and fall hangs on the mood of the powerful—this cannot be refused.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten clansmen held office; they debated: "A family's rise and fall hangs on the mood of the powerful—this cannot be refused.

sentences.zh: 損曰：「今尺寸土皆先人舊貲，非吾等所有，安可奉權臣邪？

translations.literal: Sun said: "Every inch of soil now is ancestral property from former generations—it is not ours to give; how can we serve a powerful minister?
translations.idiomatic: Sun said: "Every inch of soil now is ancestral property from former generations—it is not ours to give; how can we serve a powerful minister?

sentences.zh: 窮達，命也！」

translations.literal: Poverty and success are fate!"
translations.idiomatic: Poverty and success are fate!

sentences.zh: 卒不與。

translations.literal: In the end he did not yield.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he did not yield.

sentences.zh: 岩不悅，使損按獄黔中，逾年還。

translations.literal: Yan was displeased and had Sun investigate cases in Qianzhong; after more than a year he returned.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was displeased and had Sun investigate cases in Qianzhong; after more than a year he returned.

sentences.zh: 三遷絳州刺史。

translations.literal: Three times transferred he became Prefect of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Three times transferred he became Prefect of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 岩罷去，召為給事，遷京兆尹。

translations.literal: When Yan was dismissed he was summoned as Supervising Censor and promoted to Jingzhao Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan was dismissed he was summoned as Supervising Censor and promoted to Jingzhao Intendant.

sentences.zh: 與宰相盧攜雅不葉，復除給事中。

translations.literal: He was on poor terms with Chancellor Lu Xie and was again made Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was on poor terms with Chancellor Lu Xie and was again made Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 陝虢軍亂，逐觀察使崔蕘，命損代之，至則盡誅有罪者。

translations.literal: When the Shaan-Guo army rebelled and drove out Observation Commissioner Cui Rao, Sun was ordered to replace him; upon arrival he executed all who were guilty.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shaan-Guo army rebelled and drove out Observation Commissioner Cui Rao, Sun was ordered to replace him; upon arrival he executed all who were guilty.

sentences.zh: 拜平盧節度使，徙天平，未赴復留，卒官下。

translations.literal: He was appointed military governor of Pinglu, transferred to Tianping, did not go but was retained again, and died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed military governor of Pinglu, transferred to Tianping, did not go but was retained again, and died in office.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：夫口道先王語，行如市人，其名曰「盜儒」。

translations.literal: The commentator says: One who mouths the words of former kings yet acts like a market man—his name is "Robber Scholar."
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: One who mouths the words of former kings yet acts like a market man—his name is "Robber Scholar."

sentences.zh: 僧孺、宗閔以方正敢言進，既當國，反奮私昵黨，排擊所憎，是時權震天下，人指曰「牛李」，非盜謂何？

translations.literal: Sengru and Zongmin advanced through upright and blunt speech; once they held the state they instead roused private cliques, striking down those they hated; at the time their power shook all under heaven and men pointed and said "Niu and Li"—if not robbers, what then?
translations.idiomatic: Sengru and Zongmin rose through upright and blunt speech; once they held power they instead roused private factions and struck down those they hated; at the time their authority shook all under heaven and men pointed and said "Niu and Li"—if not robbers, what else could they be called?

sentences.zh: 逢吉險邪，稹浮躁，嗣復辯給，固無足言。

translations.literal: Fengji was treacherous and wicked, Zhen was restless and shallow, and Sifu was glib—indeed not worth speaking of.
translations.idiomatic: Fengji was treacherous and wicked, Zhen was restless and shallow, and Sifu was glib—indeed scarcely worth mentioning.

sentences.zh: 幸主孱昏，不底於戮，治世之罪人歟！

translations.literal: Fortunate that their rulers were weak and dull—they did not end in execution; are they not criminals in an age of good governance!
translations.idiomatic: Fortunate that their rulers were weak and dull—they did not end in execution; are they not criminals in an age of good governance!
